24EMCS Platform Growth  
EV Focus Delivering Tangible Results
The EMCS Motor Claims Platform continued to grow in line with accelerating EV adoption. 
Our fast and scalable onboarding capability enabled us to capture EV brands efficiently, 
which now account for 10% of total dealer claims processed through the platform..
Key Highlights: 
•Record throughput: 2.31million claims were processed through the EMCS platform in 2025, 
representing a 2%YoY increase .
•Clear market leadership: EMCS now handles 55%of all motor insurance claims in Thailand, 
reflecting sustained industry adoption.
•EV-driven dealer expansion: 116new dealers were onboarded, with 52%represented by EV 
brands, supported by fast -track onboarding to meet market demand.
•Strengthening ecosystem scale: The EMCS partner network expanded by 313 new members, 
bringing the total to 5,449 partners and further enhancing platform reach and scalability.
